title: The Race between Agentic AI Capabilities and Data Quality Control in Online Surveys
abstract: arXiv:2608.28597v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Online surveys are a foundational data collection instrument in a variety of fields, with attention checks serving as critical guardians of response quality. However, the rapid emergence of agentic AI (goal directed systems powered by a large language model (LLM) brain and/or a multimodal processing unit with tool-augmented capabilities) raises new questions about the robustness of these safeguards. We investigate how well agentic AI architectures can complete web-based surveys and pass standard attention checks. We evaluate a single-agent architecture capable of multimodal input processing and tool-based web interaction on a controlled survey sandbox. We analyze the problem from two perspectives. From an attack perspective, we demonstrate how structural vulnerabilities such as exposed DOM metadata and predictable option encoding allow agents to resolve attention checks through structured parsing only. translated_title: 智能体AI能力与在线调查数据质量控制之间的竞赛
translated_abstract: 在线调查是多个领域中基础性的数据收集工具，而注意力检查则是回答质量的关键守护者。然而，智能体AI（由大语言模型（LLM）大脑和/或具备工具增强能力的多模态处理单元驱动的目标导向系统）的迅速兴起，对这些防护机制的稳健性提出了新的问题。我们研究了智能体AI架构在多大程度上能够完成基于网络的调查并通过标准的注意力检查。我们在一个受控的调查沙箱中评估了一种能够进行多模态输入处理和基于工具的网络交互的单智能体架构。我们从两个视角分析该问题：从攻击视角，我们展示了诸如暴露的DOM元数据和可预测的选项编码等结构性漏洞，如何使智能体仅通过结构化解析就能解决注意力检查；从防御视角，我们实……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文研究了智能体AI能否完成在线调查并通过注意力检查，揭示了暴露的DOM元数据和可预测的选项编码等结构性漏洞使AI仅凭结构化解析即可通过注意力检查，并从攻击与防御双重视角为在线调查的数据质量控制提供了新见解。
en_tdlr: This paper investigates whether agentic AI can complete online surveys and pass standard attention checks, showing that structural vulnerabilities such as exposed DOM metadata and predictable option encoding allow agents to pass attention checks through structured parsing alone, offering insights from both attack and defense perspectives for survey data quality control.
